scope_basis: INTERACTIVE-NETWORK-GPU.md numbered acceptance criteria, original three-capability goal, and Apple-source-first policy

requirements.terminal: actual controlling PTY/ZLE arrows/history, Ctrl-Z/jobs/fg, Ctrl-C 130, SIGWINCH resize, binary bytes and saved-history restart; focused host raw restore/backpressure checks
requirements.network: actual VZ NAT/XNU en0, original Apple bootp routines and route/ifconfig configuration, original Libinfo/libresolv lookup, independent fresh guest DNS/TCP witness
requirements.gpu: typed guest C client/relay requests executed on host Metal, independently matched returned vectors and explicit unsupported status; session/quota/bounds checks
requirements.source_policy: pinned original Apple XNU/zsh/Libc/libplatform/resolver/Libinfo/bootp/network_cmds; project VirtIO transports, static ABI and bounded DHCP/GPU adapters remain labeled
requirements.preservation: frozen workload 0.1.0 and all nine qualified checkpoints hash-identical; physical Pi outside scope

test_policy: read-only completion audit of existing evidence; no new VM boot, broad tests or soak
limits_and_separate_future_work: experimental Apple-silicon Virtualization.framework VM, not portable-to-all-hosts or production isolation
PTY transport/job control achieved; optional compctl and multibyte locales remain absent
IPv4 fixture-qualified networking; not internet/IPv6 qualification, mDNS/search/cache or full configd/IPConfiguration service
DHCP acquisition uses original Apple routines with project bounded orchestration; no lease renewal, rebinding or ARP conflict probe
shared GPU is bounded float32 vector add (16 elements, 1024 requests/session), not arbitrary Metal, a graphics desktop or passthrough
private EFI/variable entropy not published; repeat seed use and hostile-guest security are not qualified
historical per-increment reports remain unchanged; their not-full-goal labels are superseded only by this aggregate requirement audit
